name: JobTally — Contractor Job Tracking
_home_flag_note: ?home=1 marks a launch from the installed icon. A crew member who lands there with no session and no saved crew key gets the get-back-in screen instead of the contractor sales page: his invite link IS his password, and on iOS a standalone web app can have a storage partition separate from the Safari tab he joined in, so the key is not always there.
_start_url_note: Absolute, not '.'. A relative start_url resolves against wherever the manifest was fetched from, so a crew member who installed while sitting on /?invite=<token> could get an icon pointed at a spent link. '/' always lands on the root, which knows how to route a worker with a saved crew key straight back to his clock.
